production_method: Codex built-in ImageGen localized merchandise edit
prompt: EDIT THE FIRST IMAGE. Preserve its single open gondola fixture, perspective, four shelves, back panel, side posts, plinth, current overall outline, ground anchor, and transparent background. Use image 2 as the exact empty fixture structure reference, image 3 as the allowed product-placement zones (green only), and image 4 for art style only. Change ONLY the merchandise assortment and how the merchandise fills the shelves: replace every drink bottle, sandwich, prepared meal, sushi, and non-shelf item with a coherent mix from the game's allowed shelf_general categories only: snack bags/crackers, instant noodle cups, and packaged bread/buns. Arrange products as dense, continuous shelf facings with slight natural overlap and some stock depth; do not make small isolated floating cards. Packages remain painted 2D artwork with no actual 3D meshes or thick cuboid side faces. Keep all merchandise within the four green shelf bands, with fronts turned toward E/+X. Keep fixture geometry unchanged; no canopy, no added board, no new shelf, no scenery, no text, no labels. Keep >=12% transparent margin on all sides and eliminate white flecks.

visual_qa.subject: single open gondola with integrated goods
visual_qa.product_categories: snacks, packaged bread and noodle cups visibly present; no beverages/prepared meals clearly visible
visual_qa.integration: dense shelf facings with depth cues; more natural than isolated flat cards
visual_qa.verdict: FAIL / review-only; five levels and insufficient lower margin
